rgba = Image.open(io.BytesIO(remove(raw, session=new_session(model), post_process_mask=True))).convert("RGBA")

# erode ~1px (MinFilter 3) then nudge partial edges toward 0 so the outermost blended ring drops out

a3 = a[..., None]
